items.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
items.snippet: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use any content from such domains, web…

items.title: Why AI Isn’t Ready to Tackle Our Convoluted Genomes
items.snippet: The DNA inside our cells isn’t just a series of instructions, but something far more dynamic. Like scientists, AI models don't yet have the data to properly decode it.
